summary: Iteration 8 backend tests for new /api/admin/cf-config endpoint and Cashfree production regression. 10 passed, 1 skipped (resend_email — email provider unavailable in preview, treated as env-not-code issue). New admin cf-config endpoint returns correct env/whitelist/webhook info; auth guards (401/403) work. Cashfree order creation with production keys returns valid payment_session_id, env=production, and correct GST math (base=49, cgst+sgst=8.82, total=57.82). Domain appears whitelisted at Cashfree since order creation succeeded (no 502). All prior regressions (plans, seller settings, admin orders, admin exports summary, admin delete order reversing quota) pass.
